logline: When an arrogant noblewoman catches Juliana in the poisoned Dowager Duchess's chambers, she strikes Juliana with a riding crop and sentences her to scrub the hearth, unaware that Juliana has secretly hidden the antidote and remedy journal to finish the Duchess's cure.
continuity_notes: Picks up directly from Episode 23's cliffhanger inside the West Wing bedchamber, as the brass latch turns and the door swings open to reveal an unexpected intruder confronting Lady Juliana and Prudence.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up of the ornate brass handle turning slowly on the dark wooden chamber door as it swings open.

segments.label: SOUND FX
segments.text: Heavy metallic click of the latch and the ominous low creak of the door hinges.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Wide shot of the dimly lit, vaulted bedchamber. Lady Juliana and Prudence stand rigid beside the heavy four-poster bed as a haughty blonde noblewoman in an elegant lavender empire-line gown enters, clutching a riding crop.

segments.label: ACTION
segments.text: The noblewoman halts in the center of the chamber, tapping her riding crop against her gloved palm as her cold gaze sweeps across the two maids.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium shot of the noblewoman holding the riding crop upright, regarding Juliana with disdainful authority.

segments.label: NOBLEWOMAN (Sharp, Demanding)
segments.speaker: NOBLEWOMAN
segments.text: Who are you?

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium close-up of Juliana, her gaze lowered deferentially beside the carved wooden bedpost.

segments.label: LADY JULIANA (Humble, Measured)
segments.speaker: LADY JULIANA
segments.text: Juliana, my lady. I was hired for the winter cleaning.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium shot of the noblewoman, her chin tilted up in icy condescension.

segments.label: NOBLEWOMAN (Accusatory, Strict)
segments.speaker: NOBLEWOMAN
segments.text: And who gave you permission to enter this chamber?

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up of the frail Dowager Duchess lying pale and unconscious against the white pillows, gasping weakly for air.

segments.label: ACTION
segments.text: Behind her grey skirt, Juliana quickly slips the small glass remedy vial into her apron pocket with her charcoal-dusted fingers.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up on Juliana's hand swiftly concealing the medicine bottle.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium shot of Juliana facing the noblewoman, maintaining a calm, protective facade.

segments.label: LADY JULIANA (Softly Defiant)
segments.speaker: LADY JULIANA
segments.text: I heard her. I thought Her Grace needed help.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Two-shot framing the noblewoman looking down at Juliana, bursting into mocking laughter.

segments.label: NOBLEWOMAN (Scoffing, Cruel)
segments.speaker: NOBLEWOMAN
segments.text: You thought? A new maid thinks she knows better than the physicians?

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up of Juliana's resolute expression, her eyes flashing with righteous urgency.

segments.label: LADY JULIANA (Emphatic, Defiant)
segments.speaker: LADY JULIANA
segments.text: She is suffering.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Tight close-up of the noblewoman's face twisting into a malicious sneer.

segments.label: NOBLEWOMAN (Vicious, Venomous)
segments.speaker: NOBLEWOMAN
segments.text: Then let her suffer.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up of Juliana recoiling slightly in shock at the blatant cruelty.

segments.label: LADY JULIANA (Steely, Steadfast)
segments.speaker: LADY JULIANA
segments.text: I cannot do that.

segments.label: ACTION
segments.text: The noblewoman suddenly rears back her riding crop and strikes Juliana violently across the torso.

segments.label: SOUND FX
segments.text: A sharp, stinging whip crack as the riding crop makes harsh contact.

segments.label: ACTION
segments.text: Juliana gasps in pain, clutching her stomach and bending over as she absorbs the brutal strike.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium shot of Juliana hunched over in pain, clutching her abdomen.

segments.label: NOBLEWOMAN (Cold, Threatening)
segments.speaker: NOBLEWOMAN
segments.text: You are a maid.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Low-angle shot looking past the bedpost toward the Duchess, whose trembling hand reaches out limply.

segments.label: NOBLEWOMAN (Cold, Continuing)
segments.speaker: NOBLEWOMAN
segments.text: Not a physician. Not a lady.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Dramatic low-angle wide shot of the noblewoman standing imperiously over the doubled-over Juliana.

segments.label: NOBLEWOMAN (Disdainful, Final)
segments.speaker: NOBLEWOMAN
segments.text: And certainly not a woman whose opinion matters.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up of Juliana looking down, enduring the humiliation while stifling her breath.

segments.label: LADY JULIANA (Subdued, Controlled)
segments.speaker: LADY JULIANA
segments.text: Yes, my lady.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium shot of the noblewoman turning the crop in her white-gloved hands with smug satisfaction.

segments.label: NOBLEWOMAN (Smug, Condescending)
segments.speaker: NOBLEWOMAN
segments.text: Good. Perhaps we can teach you your place.

segments.label: ACTION
segments.text: The noblewoman leads Juliana and a frightened Prudence down a dark flagstone hallway.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Low tracking shot down the corridor as the hem of the lilac dress sweeps past, followed by Juliana's swift steps.

segments.label: ACTION
segments.text: Juliana's boots step down into a dark, rustic chamber dominated by an enormous, blackened stone hearth.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Wide shot of the vast soot-stained stone fireplace. The noblewoman turns back toward Juliana, crop held at her side.

segments.label: NOBLEWOMAN (Harsh, Dismissive)
segments.speaker: NOBLEWOMAN
segments.text: Clean it.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium shot of the noblewoman extending her gloved hand toward the cavernous, filth-laden hearth.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up of Juliana looking up at the towering, soot-blackened chimney.

segments.label: LADY JULIANA (Quiet, Questioning)
segments.speaker: LADY JULIANA
segments.text: All of it, my lady?

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Extreme close-up two-shot as the noblewoman steps unnervingly close to Juliana's face, whispering with sadistic relish.

segments.label: NOBLEWOMAN (Intimate, Venomous)
segments.speaker: NOBLEWOMAN
segments.text: Every stone. Perhaps when your hands are black enough, you will finally remember what you are.

segments.label: ACTION
segments.text: Juliana slowly drops to her knees on the cold flagstones before the soot-filled fireplace.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium shot of Juliana sinking to her knees, her face grim and composed.

segments.label: ACTION
segments.text: Prudence steps toward the noblewoman in distress, her hands clasped tightly.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up of Prudence's anxious, trembling face.

segments.label: PRUDENCE (Desperate, Pleading)
segments.speaker: PRUDENCE
segments.text: My lady—

segments.label: ACTION
segments.text: The noblewoman whips around sharply, thrusting the tip of her riding crop directly into Prudence's face.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium close-up of the noblewoman baring her teeth in rage, aiming the crop threateningly.

segments.label: NOBLEWOMAN (Furious, Threatening)
segments.speaker: NOBLEWOMAN
segments.text: Do you want the same punishment?

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up of Prudence flinching in terror, lowering her eyes immediately.

segments.label: PRUDENCE (Terrified, Murmuring)
segments.speaker: PRUDENCE
segments.text: No, my lady.

segments.label: ACTION
segments.text: Juliana grips a coarse scrubbing brush with both hands and begins vigorously scraping the thick black ash across the hearthstones.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up shot of Juliana's soot-covered hands fiercely scrubbing the black ash along the stone floor.

segments.label: SOUND FX
segments.text: Rhythmic, harsh rasping sound of bristles scraping against stone.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium shot of the noblewoman leaning casually against the wooden doorframe, watching Juliana toil with smug condescension.

segments.label: NOBLEWOMAN (Smug, Gleeful)
segments.speaker: NOBLEWOMAN
segments.text: That is where clever little servants belong.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium profile shot of Juliana kneeling by the hearth in the dim window light, scrubbing steadily.

segments.label: LADY JULIANA (V.O.) (Cold, Resolute)
segments.speaker: LADY JULIANA
segments.text: Let her think I am only a maid.

segments.label: ACTION
segments.text: Juliana pauses scrubbing. Her soot-caked fingers reach into the deep pocket of her apron, carefully feeling the worn leather cover of her mother's remedy journal and the glass dropper bottle securely concealed within.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up of Juliana's soot-stained hand touching the hidden remedy book and the antidote vial inside her apron pocket.

segments.label: LADY JULIANA (V.O.) (Determined, Defiant)
segments.speaker: LADY JULIANA
segments.text: Let her believe I am ignorant.

segments.label: ACTION
segments.text: Juliana raises her head. Smudges of dark soot stain her fair cheek, but her piercing blue eyes burn with unwavering defiance and unyielding resolve as she stares toward the hallway.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Tight close-up of Juliana's soot-streaked face turning slowly toward the chamber exit, her jaw set firm as dramatic music builds to a powerful crescendo.

segments.label: LADY JULIANA (V.O.) (Steely, Unstoppable)
segments.speaker: LADY JULIANA
segments.text: I will return. You cannot stop the healer.
